integrity: Analytical proof with explicit lattice representation and elementary Voronoi integral, plus standalone reproducible finite tests; the tests are not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is for equal-weight Minkowski averages of a regular Euclidean hexagon vertex set and uniform area measure. Classical triangular-lattice Voronoi moment calculations are not claimed as new. Historical priority is provisional; independent audit has not been performed.
title: A two-stage exact quantization law for Minkowski averages of regular hexagon vertices
